showcase: Turns a DSH agent into a QQ group or private chat bot with a console, persona files, group memory and a built-in preset that strips shell and file tools.
summary: QQ chat bot over OneBot v11 running inside DSH: wake-word gating, per-chat serial turns, a single outbound path with redaction, 12 sub-plugins, an admin console, and a trimmed chat-only agent preset.
